name: Citizenship by Marriage

requirements.blocker_text: The (now-superseded-in-part) Citizenship Act's registration provisions were historically framed around a foreign WIFE of a Zimbabwean man applying for registration; a married woman is separately guaranteed the same individual capacity to acquire, lose, or be deprived of citizenship as an unmarried woman (i.e. marriage itself cannot automatically change a woman's citizenship either way). Whether and how these provisions were updated for gender-neutral treatment of a foreign husband under the 2013 Constitution was not confirmed in the sources reviewed for this build -- disclosed as an open question rather than assumed either way.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for registration as the spouse of a Zimbabwean citizen; exact current residency/waiting-period conditions were not confirmed.

sources.title: Harvard Cyberlaw Clinic-hosted text of Zimbabwe's Citizenship Act [Chapter 4:01] -- marriage-based registration historically framed around a foreign wife, and the separate guarantee that marriage alone does not change a Zimbabwean woman's own citizenship

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Zimbabwe). STATUS: DRAFT -- the hosted text used here appears to be the OLDER, pre-2013-Constitution Citizenship Act (it does not reflect the 2013 Constitution's grandparent-descent rule confirmed in zw_citizenship_by_descent.json from a separate, more current source), so this file should be treated as describing the historical statutory baseline, not necessarily current practice. UNRESOLVED, EXPLICITLY FLAGGED: whether a foreign HUSBAND of a Zimbabwean woman has an equivalent registration route was not addressed in the source reviewed -- rather than assume symmetry or asymmetry, this is disclosed as an open question requiring a dedicated follow-up against the current, 2013-onward legal framework (ideally the unamended-vs-constitution tension described in zw_citizenship_naturalisation.json's notes, which likely also affects this route). dual_citizenship_allowed set false here (distinct from the 'true' set in zw_citizenship_by_descent.json) because marriage-based acquisition is a form of registration/naturalization, not citizenship 'by birth' -- and the 2013 Constitution's dual-citizenship allowance is explicitly limited to citizens BY BIRTH, per the sources reviewed in this build; this distinction across the three Zimbabwe citizenship files is deliberate, not inconsistent.
